cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take me as the expedition photographer, not Martin. A sponsor needs usable pictures, not just lovely dunes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Martin won an award for his desert photographs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For landscapes. Your sponsor wants people using the equipment. I'll frame the flask where the logo can be read.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want the logo in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then it must face the lens, not the sun. Give me the brief; I'd rather correct the flask before we cross the desert than explain forty beautifully lit blank sides.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the stricter B4 requirement a reason for professional preparation before departure.
